_about: Public-domain Isaac Penington (1616-1679), Quaker writer, for the Word Hoard: his Works in the third edition (London, 1784, four volumes) and the fourth edition with his collected letters (Philadelphia, 1863, four volumes), and his Letters (1796 and 1829), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 34 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

penington-works-1863-2: The Works of Isaac Penington, fourth edition, vol. II (Philadelphia: Friends' Book Store, 304 Arch Street, 1863)
